nodes.label: propose_config_update MCP Tool
nodes.rationale: Admin-gated tool staging config file updates (append/replace/delete) for confirmation flow

nodes.label: list_config_files MCP Tool
nodes.rationale: Surfaces instruction files grouped by role/topic/repo with optional query filtering

nodes.label: Semantic Config File Addressing
nodes.rationale: Addresses config files by semantic fields instead of path strings

nodes.label: Slack App Manifest
nodes.rationale: Conditionally includes scopes, events, and features based on enabled trigger modes (Home Tab, DM, @mention, etc.)

nodes.label: DM Type Conditional: assistant vs classic
nodes.rationale: Determines whether manifest includes Slack Agents & Assistants API scopes/events (assistant) or classic DM events (classic)
nodes.norm_label: dm type conditional: assistant vs classic

nodes.label: escalate_to_owner Field
nodes.rationale: Optional field for Claude to escalate internal failures to operator; user sees only acknowledgement

nodes.label: Error Reporting Mechanism
nodes.rationale: Escalations persisted as ErrorReport records discoverable via admin tools

nodes.label: Repository Access Threshold
nodes.rationale: Per-repo role-based read/write thresholds; derived from role hierarchy comparison

nodes.label: answersFormat Axis
nodes.rationale: Discriminator for question shape; each format has distinct storage and reveal logic

nodes.label: questionType Axis
nodes.rationale: Static knowledge vs. recent news vs. future outcomes; affects generation path and answer settlement

nodes.label: TriviaGame Registry
nodes.rationale: Per-game data isolation; games are declared in config and reconciled into cron jobs on plugin load

nodes.label: Per-Game Data Directory
nodes.rationale: Each game owns questions.json, answers.json, cheats.json, and seasons.json

nodes.label: Enabled Flag on TriviaGame
nodes.rationale: Allows disabling games; disabled games refuse writes but allow reads (frozen-archive semantics)

nodes.label: prepCron Optional Field
nodes.rationale: Optional cron for pre-staging questions; driven by prep instruction flow; fails gracefully to inline generation

nodes.label: lockCron Optional Field
nodes.rationale: Optional cron to freeze voting on posted questions before reveal

nodes.label: difficultyRatio Axis
nodes.rationale: Per-format weights for easy/medium/hard distribution; cascades slot → season → game → workspace → default

nodes.label: liveAnswersVisible Field
nodes.rationale: Cascade member governing roster visibility on live questions

nodes.label: revealResponses Field
nodes.rationale: Controls reveal behavior: whether to show responses, just correctness, just winners, or full responses

nodes.label: allTimeRow Field
nodes.rationale: Governs All-Time leaderboard surface (normal-reveal + season-finale)

nodes.label: tellMeMore Field
nodes.rationale: Controls whether 'Tell me more' button renders on revealed card

nodes.label: Hint Axis
nodes.rationale: Optional hints; modes: none, button, inline; minDifficulty gates rendering

nodes.label: list_games MCP Tool
nodes.rationale: Member-gated tool returning games + workspace defaults + cron job UUIDs

nodes.label: upsert_game MCP Tool
nodes.rationale: Admin tool to create/update game config; persists cascading axis overrides

nodes.label: Migration 019: Trivia Games Data Move
nodes.rationale: Converts legacy dispatcher-style trivia cron jobs to config.trivia.games[] entries and moves flat-file data to per-game directories

nodes.label: Prediction Question Type
nodes.rationale: Future events researched via WebSearch; saved without answer key; settled via admin tool before reveal

nodes.label: settle_question MCP Tool
nodes.rationale: Admin tool to decide prediction outcome or invalidate any question

nodes.label: answerLocked Flag
nodes.rationale: Single source of truth for voting freeze; absent reads as unlocked

nodes.label: lock_questions MCP Tool
nodes.rationale: Freezes voting on posted, unrevealed questions; idempotent and per-card isolated

nodes.label: SeasonEntry
nodes.rationale: Non-overlapping season intervals; 'current' is derived from now; carries cascading axis overrides

nodes.label: Cascade Axes System
nodes.rationale: Four-tier resolution for all trivia configuration axes; first tier wins with whole-object replace

nodes.label: promptMedium Axis
nodes.rationale: Visual modality axis; independent roll from answersFormat; composes freely with all three answer formats

nodes.label: Image Search Plugin Contract
nodes.rationale: External plugins provide image sources; trivia gracefully falls back to text when no image available

hyperedges.description: Three independent trigger modes for Clack: reactions, DMs, and mentions
